seed_prompt: How might India-based Model UN delegates react to the current MUN Prep workspace, its 3-day no-card trial, and ₹199 weekly / ₹299 monthly passes?

nodes.name: MUN Prep App
nodes.summary: India-first Model UN preparation workspace with research, writing, and debate tools.

attributes.audience: Model UN delegates in India, 14 to 22, English-medium, preparing for a specific conference date

nodes.name: 3-day free trial
nodes.summary: Three days of access on signup with no payment card required.

nodes.name: Weekly Pass · ₹199
nodes.summary: Seven days of paid access for conference-week preparation.

nodes.name: Monthly Pass · ₹299
nodes.summary: Thirty days of paid access for multi-conference preparation.

nodes.name: Research & country policy
nodes.summary: Committee brief, country policy, blocs, and debate angles.

nodes.name: Position papers & speeches
nodes.summary: Position paper and speech-building workspaces.

nodes.name: POIs & resolutions
nodes.summary: Practice points of information and resolution strategy.

nodes.name: Checkable source proof
nodes.summary: A future validation need repeatedly present in the synthetic panel; do not imply it is fully solved by the current product.

nodes.name: Independent delegate proof
nodes.summary: A real, consented delegate example or recommendation; no testimonial is invented in this scenario.

nodes.name: Coach / existing materials
nodes.summary: Some delegates already rely on a coach, templates, or senior-shared preparation.

nodes.name: Generic AI substitution
nodes.summary: Delegates compare a specialist MUN workflow with free general-purpose AI tools.
